mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, /* 이후 DB 수정 후 추가. */ /*u.gender, u.birth, u.email_verified, u.enabled, u.show_reviews, u.show_likes, u.show_bookmarks, u.show_following, u.show_followers,*/ u.last_login_at, ro.name AS role FROM social_account sa JOIN user u ON u.id = sa.user_id JOIN root r ON r.id = u.id JOIN role ro ON ro.id = u.role_id WHERE sa.provider = #{provider} AND sa.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (id, role_id, email, password, nickname, description, gender, year) VALUES (#{id}, (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'USER'), #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{description}, #{gender}, #{year})

INSERT INTO social_account (user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email, email_verified, display_name, avatar_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail}, #{emailVerified}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl})
